notes.title: added untested mac and linux support
notes.notes: Demon's Wrath is now available on Mac and Linux on Steam! I haven't tested it though, hopefully the config is good.

notes.title: General improvements including boss fight and environment
notes.notes: improved grass, added in-game item store (press esc), updated start menu, improved boss fight, added some kind of collapsed cave for Robert's dad, added footstep sound, background tracks, and boss fight track. Also changed the way quest data is stored to make it more futureproof - old saves will not work with this new version.
